cross-format-embedded-application-trap-f: Keyboard focus moves into an embedded frame, plug-in, or widget and gets stuck there, with no way to Tab back out to the rest of the page.
modal-popover-legitimate-containment-vs-: A dialog that keeps focus inside itself is fine only if you can close it by keyboard, such as Escape or a reachable Close button, otherwise it traps you.
esc-standard-exit-method-no-advice-owed: A focus loop that releases when you press a normal exit key like Escape is acceptable and needs no instructions, so flagging it as a trap would be a false alarm.
arrow-key-roving-tabindex-composite-widg: In a menu or grid, arrow keys move you around inside the widget but Tab is also swallowed, so keyboard users cannot move focus out to the rest of the page.
multi-element-region-loop-tab-must-exit: Tabbing through a section wraps back to that section's first control instead of moving on to the rest of the page, trapping the user in an endless loop within one region.
input-gate-required-interaction-exceptio: A section that won't let focus move on until you fill a required field looks like a trap but is fine, as long as you can satisfy it by keyboard.
documented-exit-reachability-and-accurac: When escaping a focus loop needs a special key combo, the instructions must actually reach the trapped keyboard user and correctly name the key, not be hidden or wrong.
